summary: The one-sense semantic ruling, preferred gloss, seven-family count, source mix, and anti-metaphysical warning are sound. The product nevertheless fails exact-actor review because every named occurrence is flattened to the role 'utterer', including five explicitly adjudicated verse authors and one authored prose work; the unlinked Puming witness is likewise mislabeled as an unidentified generic actor and utterer. These are bounded metadata repairs, not a semantic rewrite.
